why_it_was_global: it assembled one snapshot from live singletons and ignored the caller except for a conversation id used only to filter recent events; projects, checkpoints, self-model project names, execution events and the executive last-action were all install-wide

callers_audited.scope: optional { conversationId }; no identity → operational only
the AgentTaskScope; no scope → operational only

findings.finding: The snapshot listed every active/paused project and its checkpoint, bypassing the M22.1 project boundary entirely. Another user's project and a conversation-local project both arrived.
findings.evidence: isProjectVisible applied in the snapshot; formatCognitiveContext labels a project from another chat; tests X

findings.finding: Recent execution events included ownerless tool results, so "Project X created" from one conversation appeared in every scope, including anonymous snapshots.
findings.evidence: only events owned by the requesting conversation are included; none without an identity

findings.finding: The executive "last action" carried a tool result (a project name, a file, a message) into every scope.
findings.evidence: VerifiedAction records its owning conversation; getSelfStateText(conversationId) shows it only there

findings.finding: SelfModel.state.projects is a second copy of project names, unscreened.
findings.evidence: filtered to names the scope is authorized to see

findings.finding: Agent requests with no scope received the full global snapshot by calling buildCognitiveContext() with no argument.
findings.evidence: delegate passes its AgentTaskScope; absent scope yields operational state only

invocation_identity.agentId: already the runner's argument; the request carries the agent's own system prompt
invocation_identity.taskId: the agent task / cognitive turn id
invocation_identity.authorization: project visibility, event ownership, last-action ownership

rejected: a snapshot with no identity no longer includes projects, checkpoints, execution events or a last action. The builder does not fall back to global state.
residual: Self-model fields other than project names (knows, goals, discoveries) are durable self-knowledge and are shown; they are not conversation content.
Capabilities, UI, configuration, Earth/executive telemetry are operational state, shared by design and carry no user content.
